id.description: Unique identifier for the logical object that instance of this type represents.

name.description: The name of the component. Optional field for informational purposes only.

dataSpec.description:
The data settings for this component.

@uiSdlDesignerCustomRenderer(rendererType='')

disableDataRequestOnFirstRender.description: Disable if you want to avoid sending any and all requests for this component on first render.

triggersRegistered.description: Whether the effect triggers and epics have been registered

wrapWithMetadataId.description: Whether to wrap the component with a div which has a class name of its metdata id. Useful for targeting with css.

muteDuration.description:
The date until which alerts should be muted.

This field stores the user-selected end date for the mute period.
When alerts are muted, they will remain muted until this date is reached.
The date is used as the default end date for new muted periods and overrides.

applyNewMuteDurationToAll.description:
Whether to apply the new mute duration to all {@link ReliabilityMlModel models} and {@link Sensor sensors}

When true, the #muteDuration will be applied to all models and sensors with mute period enabled, either existing
or new - i.e. models and sensors in #newMutedPeriods and #mutedPeriodOverrides.
When false, the #muteDuration will only be applied to #newMutedPeriods.

muteChildAssets.description:
Whether to mute alerts for child {@link ReliabilityAsset assets} as well.

When true, alerts will be muted for the selected asset and all its child assets.
When false, only the selected asset itself will be affected.

allAssets.description:
All of the assets from currentAssetId {ReliabilityAsset#currentRelDenormDescendants} to get data
from if #muteChildAssets is true

muteAssetAlerts.description:
Whether to mute {@link ReliabilityAssetAlert}s on the {@link ReliabilityAsset asset}.

When true, alerts generated by the CHAMPION {@link ReliabilityMlModel models} of the asset will be muted.
This includes alerts related to asset health, performance, and other asset-level issues.

muteSensorAlerts.description:
Whether to mute {@link SensorHealthAlert}s on the {@link Sensor sensors} associated with the
{@link ReliabilityAsset asset}.

When true, alerts generated by sensors associated with the {@link ReliabilityAsset asset} will be muted.
This includes alerts related to sensor readings, thresholds, and sensor-specific issues.

mutedPeriodOverrides.description:
Map of specifications to update existing {@link AlertMutedPeriod}s.

This map contains override specifications for existing muted periods. Each entry
specifies how to modify an existing muted period, typically by updating its end date
or changing its status.

Key: {@link ReliabilityMlModel#id} or {@link Sensor#id}
Value: Override specification object with the following structure:
{
  "type": {@link ReliabilityAlertType} - The type of alert being muted
  "parent": {@link ReliabilityAsset} - The asset associated with this mute period
  "action": string enum ("MUTE", "UNMUTE") - The action to perform on the muted period
  "start": datetime - Start date of the muted period
  "end": datetime - End date of the muted period (defaults to #muteDuration if not specified)
}

newMutedPeriods.description:
Map of specifications to create new {@link AlertMutedPeriod}s.

This map contains specifications for creating new muted periods. Each entry
defines a new muted period that will be created when the user applies their changes.

Key: {@link ReliabilityMlModel#id} or {@link Sensor#id}
Value: New muted period specification object with the following structure:
{
  "type": {@link ReliabilityAlertType} - The type of alert being muted
  "parent": {@link ReliabilityAsset} - The asset associated with this mute period
  "action": string enum ("MUTE", "UNMUTE") - The action to perform on the muted period
  "start": datetime - Start date of the muted period
  "end": datetime - End date of the muted period (defaults to #muteDuration if not specified)
}

assetGraphData.description:
Graph data from {@link AssetGraphHelper#getMuteAlertStatusAssetGraph}.

This field stores the asset graph data returned by the {@link AssetGraphHelper} to avoid
refetching when updating the UI based on user selections. The graph data contains
vertices (assets) and edges (relationships) with mute status information.

currentAssetId.description:
The {@link ReliabilityAsset#id} for which the graph data is currently stored.

This field tracks which asset's graph data is currently loaded in #assetGraphData.
It is used to determine whether the graph data needs to be refreshed when
switching between different assets or when the asset context changes.

selectedSensorsIds.description:
The {@link Sensor#id}s that are currently selected in the sensors grid.

This field tracks selected {@link Sensor#id}s. It is updated when the user
selects or deselects a {@link Sensor} in the grid.

sensors.description:
List of {@link Sensor} objects associated with the current {@link ReliabilityAsset}.

This field stores the sensors that are available for muting alerts.
It is populated when the application state is initialized.

models.description:
List of {@link ReliabilityMlModel} objects associated with the current {@link ReliabilityAsset}.

This field stores the CHAMPION models that are available for muting alerts.
It is populated when the application state is initialized.

selectedSensorHealthAlertsIds.description:
The {@link SensorHealthAlert#id}s that are currently selected in the Asset detail > Sensor Alerts grid.

This field tracks selected {@link SensorHealthAlert#id}s. It is updated when the user
clicks on the `Mute Sensors` multiple row action in the grid.

title:
This application state manages the UI state and user interactions for configuring {@link AlertMutedPeriod}s.
It stores user selections for muting alerts on {@link ReliabilityAsset assets}, {@link ReliabilityMlModel models},
and {@link Sensor sensors}, including:
- Mute duration settings
- Alert scope configuration (which assets/models/sensors to mute)
- Override specifications for existing muted periods
- New muted period specifications
- Asset graph data for visualization

The state is designed to work with the mute alert enhancement features, providing
a centralized way to manage all mute-related UI state and user interactions.
name: AlertMutedPeriodApplicationState
